name: Himekawa Yoshino
source:
Code name: "Hermit" 
Angel: Zadkiel 
Astral Dress: El

Second Spirit to appear, and the kindest spirit up to date. She's very shy and relies on her Hand Puppet Yoshinon to communicate with others. She causes rain to fall whenever she appears, which is part of her ability to control the three states of water. Mainly uses ice attacks though.

[Taken from [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/DateALive]TVTropes[/url]]
